# Lens project

This repository is a Lens project: a `lens.toml`, a `narrative/` tree of prose,
and a `knowledge/` store of small objects that AI operators assemble into
prompts.

**Run `lens skill` for the current guidance.** It is generated by the installed
Lens, against this project — which datasets are active, which types and tags
exist, which modules this project actually has. Run it before you touch
`knowledge/`, and before you assume anything about the CLI surface (`lens
--help`, `lens <command> --help`).

Nothing else in this file explains how Lens works. This file was committed once;
Lens keeps moving, and a description that ages in the repository is wrong
silently.

## If `lens` cannot be run

You can still edit files, so these three are worth stating anyway. Each one
fails without an error:

1. **`knowledge/` is not the whole store.** It merges with read-only dataset
   trees that live outside this repository. `grep` over the checkout misses
   them.
2. **Editing a file inside a dataset edits it for every project using that
   dataset.** Files under this repository's own `knowledge/` are yours; anything
   else needs `lens kb` to fork a local copy first.
3. **Tags live in `knowledge/tags.toml`, not in the object files.** A file
   created with a text editor has no tags and no index entry: invisible to tag
   lookups, never reached by link expansion.
